Perform line voxelization between each pair of sorted vertices $(V_{min}, V_{mid})$ and $(V_{mid}, V_{max})$ using a Ray Casting Line Voxelization (RLV) algorithm.
Split the voxelized edges into slices along the dominant axis.
A slice is defined by an integer value $k$ of the dominant axis.
For each integer $k$ between the minimum and maximum dominant-axis coordinates of the triangle, identify the two points on the triangle edges that lie on the plane $z=k$ (or $x=k$ or $y=k$).
